in_marathi.name: Likhita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Drawn, depicted, inscribed
in_marathi.long_meaning: Likhita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'lekh', meaning 'to draw, depict, or inscribe'. Likhita is a name for a girl who is skilled in the arts, especially writing or calligraphy. This name embodies creativity and the power of expression.
